summary: The quest artifact wish reaches invent.c:addinv_core1, whose missing quest.c:artitouch call skips the first-touch quest pager. That pager initializes nhlib.lua and draws the two shuffle values seen before the reported RNG mismatch; the later artifact invocation is downstream of this missing pickup side effect.

source.branch: First acquisition of a role quest artifact when Qstat(touched_artifact) is false; invent.c:addinv_core1 calls artitouch before inventory insertion.
callers: C zap.c:makewish -> invent.c:hold_another_object -> addinv_core0/addinv_core1 -> quest.c:artitouch; JS makewish -> hold_another_object -> addinvCore0Runtime/beginAddinv -> currently note_unported(quest.c artitouch).

C pickup.c:pick_obj and container take-out enter addinv_core1 on first acquisition; in-place zap.c:poly_obj also calls addinv_core1 but cannot create a fresh quest artifact through its mkobj/mksobj replacement.
dependencies: questpgr.c:qt_pager("gotit") is already async in js/questpgr.js and initializes a fresh Lua pager state, consuming the two shuffle draws.
invent.c:addinv_core1 must await the pager before inventory insertion on async runtime callers; audit synchronous addinv and replace_inventory_core boundaries.
questpgr.c:skip_pager during files.c:wizkit_addinv is a separate startup dependency; retain that source edge as a documented gap if no JS wizkit route exists.

The checked-in js/quest_text_data.js omits gotit messages because scripts/generate-quest-text.mjs NEEDED_MESSAGES excludes gotit; generate the full role-specific gotit table from source and validate it with the existing generated-data check.

C questpgr.c:com_pager_core calls skip_pager(TRUE) before Lua initialization; wizkit_wishing suppresses lookup and shuffle draws, so port/test that guard or explicitly document the unavailable startup route.

evidence: At segment 0 step 24 in challenges/evaluations/20260927130815-v8.json, C calls rnd(2) at next_ident then rn2(3) and rn2(2) from nhlib.lua shuffle, while JS instead calls rn2(100) in zap.c:makewish. Earlier startup and wishing RNG match, so the missing pager side effect starts at artifact acquisition.

C invent.c:addinv_core1 at line 989 calls quest.c:artitouch for a quest artifact; js/invent.js:addinv_core1 currently records note_unported(quest.c artitouch). quest.c:artitouch at lines 125-137 observes the object, sets Qstat(touched_artifact), calls qt_pager("gotit"), and exercises Wisdom in that order.

The sole direct C caller of artitouch is invent.c:addinv_core1, before addinv_core0 inserts the item. The v8 case is a wish-acquisition witness; a fresh independent role/artifact recipe should verify production wiring and pager order.

The first RNG annotation names nhlib.lua:shuffle, but the upstream owner of the missing call is quest.c:artitouch. Existing js/questpgr.js has the pager initialization; implement the source caller rather than adding an isolated shuffle draw.

The A27 caller audit found no generated gotit text in js/quest_text_data.js and no skip_pager in js/questpgr.js. These are source dependencies of the first-touch pager and must be resolved before runtime evidence can close the port.
